description:
Cast Here Comes a New Hero! by paying {5}{U}, targeting Biovisionary.
Holding priority, activate Echo Mage by tapping it, copying Here Comes a New Hero! twice, with both copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Here Comes a New Hero! spells, creating three token copies of Biovisionary and causing a player to draw nine cards.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers. Resolve the first trigger, causing you to win the game.

uses.name: Echo Mage
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and is level 4 or higher
